summary: All 3 fixes are correctly implemented. Fix 1: needs_plan added to SPRINT_FIELDS with proper description, example, and optional flag matching the existing WorkerHandoffBaseSchema. Fix 2: Both FLYWHEEL_SPRINT_WORKER_CAN_ESCALATE and FLYWHEEL_SPRINT_ESCALATE_ON_STUCK env var overrides follow the exact pattern of the existing FLYWHEEL_SPRINT_ESCALATE_TO_FULL handler (boolean with 'true'/'1' parsing, sprint object initialization guard). Fix 3: MockAdapter now has an exhaustive switch statement covering all 42 FlywheelEvent types including all 6 sprint events, with assertNever in the default case for compile-time safety, matching the pattern used by OpenTUI and Headless adapters. Test coverage is thorough: 19 tests across all 3 fixes, covering positive cases, edge cases (numeric '1' boolean), defaults, and a sequence integration test. Worker followed TDD procedure correctly (red-green confirmed in transcript). Only non-blocking issue: AGENTS.md config table should be updated to list the new env vars.
